takeaway: The oesophagus crosses the diaphragm at T10, accompanied by the anterior and posterior gastric nerves.

question.text: At which vertebral level does the oesophagus cross the diaphragm?

lines.text: Count down the spine on the left, and stop at the golden block.
The oesophagus traverses the middle of the diaphragm at the level of T ten.
lines.say: The oesophagus traverses the middle of the diaphragm at the level of T ten.

lines.text: It does not go alone: the vagus nerves dance through the hole beside it.
At this point they are the anterior and posterior gastric nerves.
They rotate anticlockwise, because they follow the rotation of the gut.
Small oesophageal branches of the left gastric vessels, and a few lymphatics, pass through here too.
So the oesophagus crosses at T ten.
lines.say: (sigh) So the oesophagus crosses at T ten.
